newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 114,000/T Mar fuel oil at $142.50/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 114,000/T Mar fuel oil at $142.50/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded its tender to buy 114,000 tonnes of fuel oil at around $142.50 per tonne on a cost and freight (c-and-f) basis during March 11-30, industry sources said on Friday.

The three 38,000-tonne cargoes of low pour point 0.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil to be delivered to Keelung, Koahsiung or Shen Ao, were purchased from Japanese trader Petrodiamond, Japanese refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd and western trader Astra.
The tender closed on February 12 and was valid until February 13.
In its last tender for March 1-5 delivery, CPC had purchased two cargoes of low sulphur fuel oil, a high pour point cargo and a low pour cargo at $135-$138 per tonne, c-and-f.
